purpose: Define implementation evidence for P02 without itself authorizing physical schema.
migration_evidence: Add only the admitted Identity and ApplicationSession physical records in the next immutable ordered migration after SLICE-P01.
Applying the complete migration history to two independently empty PostgreSQL databases must produce identical schema fingerprints.
Applying pending P02 migration(s) to the current P01 schema must succeed and reconcile to the same migration-defined schema.
Already-applied migrations remain immutable; direct db push/manual shared or production DDL remains forbidden.
No shared or production migration execution is authorized by this plan.
acceptance_evidence: Credential generation/verifier tests prove exactly 32 random bytes, unpadded base64url presentation, v1 domain-separated SHA-256 verifier, and no raw credential persistence.
Stored verifier material presented as a credential must not authenticate.
Session expiry tests prove 12-hour absolute and 30-minute idle deadlines fail closed even if an EXPIRED-state persistence write fails.
ApplicationSession must belong to exactly one Identity through non-null approved IdentityHasApplicationSession shape.
ApplicationSession data-access methods must require authoritative IdentityId for protected reads/writes.
Identity and ApplicationSession schema/repositories must not copy organization, location, role, or capability authority fields.
Identity DELETED ingress and deletion/retention automation remain absent while C15 OQ-PRIV-1/2/3 are unresolved.
Session runtime cookie/CSRF/rotation behavior remains out of scope while OQ-SES-1/2/5/6 are unresolved.
Static repository-boundary proof rejects foreign-module writes to Identity-owned persistence.
P02 implementation PR must attach migration replay, typecheck, domain tests, PostgreSQL integration tests, admission-boundary validation, and review closure.
